description: Create an email draft. Supports body_file with YAML frontmatter. Use reply_to for threaded reply drafts, where to and subject are derived from the parent message and may be omitted; pass reply_all=false with reply_to to draft a sender-only reply.

attachments.description: Files to attach. Each entry takes a sandboxed `path` or inline `base64`.

base64.description: Inline standard-base64-encoded file content. Alternative to path.

filename.description: Attachment filename. Defaults to basename(path); REQUIRED when using base64.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type hint. Overrides ZIP-container extension inference (Office/ODF documents are recognized without it); recognized JPEG/PNG/GIF/PDF magic bytes remain authoritative.

path.description: Path to a file, sandboxed like body_file. Relative paths resolve against the working directory only; files in a directory the operator allowlisted via AGENT_EMAIL_ALLOWED_DIRS must be given as an ABSOLUTE path (a leading ~ is not expanded here).

body_file.description: Path to a .md/.html/.txt file to use as the body. Sandboxed like attachment paths: relative paths resolve against the working directory only; files in an AGENT_EMAIL_ALLOWED_DIRS root must be given as an ABSOLUTE path (a leading ~ is not expanded here).

force_black.description: Wrap rendered HTML in a force-black div so Outlook dark mode does not hide the text. Default true.

format.description: Body format. 'markdown' (default) renders via GFM with line-break preservation; 'html' is passthrough; 'text' sends as plain text.

include_quoted.description: Include provider-assembled quoted history in preview.bodyHtml. This affects only the preview, never the stored or sent body.

reply_all.description: Only relevant when reply_to is set. When false, the draft replies only to the original sender. Default true preserves reply-all behavior (cc the original thread).

to.description: Recipient address(es). Required for a new draft; optional with reply_to set, where recipients are derived from the parent message. When supplied alongside reply_to it replaces the provider-derived To rather than adding to it, so the draft is addressed to exactly these recipients. Under reply_all, thread participants displaced from the To line move to Cc rather than being dropped; pass reply_all=false to address the reply to these recipients alone.

name: create_draft

bodyHtmlTruncated.description: True if preview.bodyHtml was truncated to fit the MCP response budget. The persisted draft body is unchanged.

bodyTruncated.description: True if preview.body was truncated to fit the MCP response budget. The persisted draft body is unchanged.

quotedHistoryOmitted.description: True only when preview.bodyHtml omits provider-assembled quoted history. The persisted draft body is unchanged.
